ref_text: THOUGHT KILLS ME THAT I AM NOT THOUGHT TO LEAP LARGE LENGTHS OF MILES WHEN THOU ART GONE BUT THAT SO MUCH OF EARTH AND WATER WROUGHT I MUST ATTEND TIME'S LEISURE WITH MY MOAN RECEIVING NOUGHT BY ELEMENTS SO SLOW BUT HEAVY TEARS BADGES OF EITHER'S WOE
text: Thought kills me that I am not thought. To leap large lengths of miles when thou art gone, but that so much of earth and water rot. I must attend times leisure with my moan. Receiving not by elements so slow, but heavy tears, badges of either's woe.
